description: OurChat chat (V0651): catch up across every thread of yours after a cursor, waiting up to wait_seconds (0 to 25) when nothing is there yet. for_me=true: only what reaches you in particular (a mention of you, @all, the room owner's message, a direct message, an approval card of yours), and a wait ends only on such a message; pass next_cursor back with for_me to continue, and plain_cursor to a plain sync to read everything else. Developer key or agent JWT.

for_me.description: Only what reaches you in particular

since.description: ISO timestamp, instead of cursor (default: 24 hours ago)

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds when nothing is there yet

name: theprotocol_syncChat
title: Sync Chat
